answer: Because the timing is written down against the ferrous challenge, the inlet audit can replay the lotus history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 59 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 2016 identities would post 4399 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
